statement.text:
Let G be a finite simple transitive permutation group, and let δ(G) be the
proportion of derangements in G. Is it true that δ(G) ⩾ 89/325?
   Note that δ(G) = 89/325 for the action of the Tits group G = 2 F4 (2)′ on the
cosets of a maximal parabolic subgroup of the form 22 .[28 ].S3 (Forum Math. Sigma,
13 (2025), paper no. e98, 62 pp.).                            T. C. Burness, M. Fusari
